assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape background illustration for a real interactive web app called MINDSPACE, no lettering. Create a beautiful premium handcrafted miniature clay brain-world seen from a fixed slightly elevated frontal viewpoint, landscape 1536x1024. Four clearly separated rounded miniature districts arranged in a diamond-square inside the silhouette of a soft sculpted brain, connected by thin dormant winding neural pathways and surrounded by dark aubergine negative space #151020. Exact district centres in image coordinates: Achievement at 32% width 34% height, Connection at 68% width 34% height, Discovery at 32% width 67% height, Recovery at 68% width 67% height. Achievement is a small golden clay desk nook with closed notebook and little sculpted star; Connection a tiny dusty pink garden with two EMPTY curved seats and one little heart sculpture; Discovery a misty blue miniature observatory with books and telescope; Recovery a sage green cozy sleeping nook with crescent cushion and tiny cloud sculpture. Rich readable sculpted objects, cosy tactile textures, same visual language as a miniature stop motion movie set. Entire brain fits within central 80% width and 80% height, clean empty margins, continuous unobstructed connected world. No text, labels, UI, panels, split screen, borders, watermark, numbers. Keep clear paths between district centres, they will have animated light overlays in code.
